violations.message: Image element completely missing 'alt' attribute. Screen readers will read filename.
violations.remediation: Add meaningful alt="Ethereum Logo" or alt="" if decorative.

violations.message: Button contains only an icon with no accessible text or aria-label.
violations.remediation: Add aria-label="Transaction Settings" to the icon button.

violations.message: Custom interactive control is built with a non-semantic element without keyboard accessibility.
violations.remediation: Replace with native <button> or add role='button' and tabindex='0' with Enter/Space key handlers.

violations.message: Custom interactive control is built with a non-semantic element without keyboard accessibility.
violations.remediation: Replace with native <button> or add role='button' and tabindex='0' with Enter/Space key handlers.

violations.message: Color contrast ratio 3.87:1 fails WCAG 2.1 Level AA requirement (min 4.5:1).
violations.remediation: Increase text brightness to at least #9da3b4 for a ratio >= 4.5:1.

passes.detail: Skip-to-content link found and correctly targets element #main-content.
Image has valid alt attribute: "USDC Logo".
Button #theme-toggle has accessible name: "Toggle light and dark color theme".
Button #pay-token-select has accessible name: "Select source token, currently Ethereum (ETH)".
Button #switch-direction-btn has accessible name: "Switch token swap direction".
Button #receive-token-select has accessible name: "Select destination token, currently USD Coin (USDC)".
Button #execute-swap-btn has accessible name: "Enter an amount".
Button #modal-close-btn has accessible name: "Close transaction confirmation dialog".
Document correctly uses primary HTML5 / ARIA landmarks: <header>, <nav>, and <main>.
Modal dialog correctly implements role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and aria-labelledby.
